Juvederm

Juvederm® Ultra 3 with Lidocaine (2 × 1ml)

Juvederm Ultra 3 with Lido Dermal Filler 2x1ml is a medium-strength hyaluronic acid injectable designed for moderate line correction, contour enhancement, and balanced soft tissue augmentation with integrated lidocaine for improved comfort.

Pricing is available to registered aesthetic professionals only.

Description

Juvederm Ultra 3 with Lido Dermal Filler 2x1ml

Juvederm Ultra 3 with Lido Dermal Filler 2x1ml is a versatile hyaluronic acid (HA) injectable formulated to address moderate facial lines, contour deficiencies, and soft volume loss. Produced by Allergan Aesthetics, this product utilises Vycross® technology, combining low and high-molecular-weight HA chains in a smooth, cohesive gel that integrates predictably into tissue. The integrated lidocaine enhances patient comfort during injection.

Juvederm Ultra 3 is positioned between lighter surface fillers and more robust volumisers, making it ideal for natural-appearing soft enhancement and medium-depth correction in both facial lines and lip augmentation.

What Juvederm Ultra 3 Is Similar To

Juvederm Ultra 3 can be regarded alongside other medium-strength hyaluronic acid dermal fillers intended for moderate soft tissue correction and contouring, such as Juvederm Ultra Plus and other cross-linked HA gels with balanced rheology. These products are designed to provide reliable integration, smooth texture correction, and controlled enhancement. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply direct interchangeability.

Treatment Areas / Indications

According to manufacturer documentation and clinical practice, Juvederm Ultra 3 with lidocaine is indicated for:

Treatment areas:

  • Moderate nasolabial folds and marionette lines

  • Cheek contour enhancement

  • Lip augmentation and definition

  • Perioral lines and superficial contour correction

→ Juvederm Ultra 3 is frequently used as a go-to filler for patients requiring moderate volume, improved surface contours, and balanced soft enhancement. It is also commonly utilised as a juvederm ultra 3 lip filler where moderate lip projection and definition are desired.

Usage / Administration (IFU-Only)

Injection depth: Superficial to mid-dermal depending on treatment area.
Volume per injection site: Determined by clinical assessment based on indication and anatomy.
Needle gauge: Fine gauge injector suitable for superficial and intermediate placement.
Frequency / number of sessions: Single session may be appropriate; additional touch-ups can be considered depending on clinical response.
Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions.
If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU it is marked: “not provided by manufacturer.”

Ingredient List

  • Hyaluronic acid sodium salt: Cross-linked HA using Vycross® technology for cohesive, smooth integration.

  • Lidocaine hydrochloride: Integrated anaesthetic to reduce injection discomfort.

Other excipients: Physiological buffers and stabilisers as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed.

Presentation & Longevity

Presentation: Two 1 ml pre-filled sterile syringes (total 2 ml).
Shelf-life: Refer to product packaging for expiration details.
Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically observed immediately and may last 9–12 months depending on anatomical location, patient metabolism, and injection technique.

Juvederm Ultra 3 price varies by region, distributor, and clinic strategy; practitioners should consult authorised channels when they buy Juvederm Ultra 3 and align pricing accordingly.

Safety Notes / Contraindications

  • Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the formulation.

  • Avoid use in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin condition.

  • Do not inject intravascularly; slow injection with aspiration recommended.

  • Single-use only; do not reuse syringe.

  • Strict aseptic technique and detailed anatomical understanding are essential.

Regulatory Status

Juvederm Ultra 3 with Lidocaine is CE-marked as a medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification, indications, and approved uses may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should verify compliance via the official IFU and local regulatory guidance.

FAQ

1. What is Juvederm Ultra 3?
Juvederm Ultra 3 is a medium-strength hyaluronic acid dermal filler formulated with Vycross® technology and lidocaine, designed for moderate lines, soft contour enhancement, and balanced volume correction.

2. How does Juvederm Ultra 3 work in the tissue?
The cross-linked HA gel integrates into the superficial to mid-dermal layers, attracting and retaining water to improve hydration, smooth contours, and provide moderate volume enhancement. Lidocaine helps reduce discomfort during injection.

3. Can Juvederm Ultra 3 be used for lips?
Yes. Juvederm Ultra 3 for lips is commonly used for moderate lip augmentation and definition, providing balanced fullness and natural movement.

4. How long do results from Juvederm Ultra 3 last?
Results are typically seen immediately and may last 9-12 months depending on the patient’s physiology, treatment area, and injection technique.

5. What should practitioners consider regarding Juvederm Ultra 3 price?
Juvederm Ultra 3 price depends on distributor pricing, regional factors, and clinic pricing strategy. Practitioners should consult authorised distributors when they buy Juvederm Ultra 3 to ensure product authenticity and current pricing.
